items.title: Engineers work to reposition flood-displaced bridge on Galchhi-Trishuli-Mailung road
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 13 Both the old and new motorable bridges over Kolpu Khola on the Galchhi-Trishuli-Mailung road were damaged by the August 26 flood, disrupting a key route connecting Dhading and Nuwakot with Rasuwa. items.title: NEA begins relief payments to families of employees missing in Bhotekoshi Flood
items.summary: Kathmandu, October 13 The Nepal Electricity Authority (NEA) has begun providing relief payments to the families of its employees who went missing in the Bhotekoshi flood on August 26. A total of 47 NEA employees went missing in the disaster. The Authority has initially provided relief to the families of six of them.
